value.rationale: The precise finite equal-rate absorbing chain is a natural positivity test for a stiff spectral integrator used in transfer problems. The full two-through-five-state classification proves a nonmonotone transition (failure then exact recovery), and a sharp first unsafe dimension inside the actual stiff nondimensional window; it distinguishes modal damping from stochasticity without asserting a broader physical claim.
